Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental conceptual error in physics/chemistry by incorrectly defining the mass number of an atom. It stated that the mass number is the sum of protons and electrons (6+6=12), whereas the mass number is the sum of protons and neutrons. Additionally, it incorrectly concluded that the answer was C) 12, when option C in the provided list is 13. This error stems from a misapplication of domain-specific knowledge regarding atomic structure, specifically ignoring the contribution of neutrons to atomic mass and the negligible mass of electrons.
